raw_response:
This rice plot is small, only a small piece of my land, but rice needs water and food to grow well. I saw my neighbor last year put one bag of urea on his rice and he got more grain, so I will try to get one bag too if I have the money when the dealer brings it. I have no schooling but I know rice likes wet ground, so I plant in the low place where water sits, but I cannot pump water — I wait for the rain. I keep the seed from last year like my father did, because buying new seed every year is too much money for a small plot.
